bell_menu.title: Doorbell
bell_menu.description: Settings and time window profiles of the doorbell.

data.action: What would you like to do?

data_description.trigger_entity: binary_sensor (triggers on change to on) or event entity (triggers on every event).
data_description.debounce_seconds: Further rings within this time are ignored.

profile_basic.title: Time window profile
profile_basic.description: Time window, sound and app push of this profile. All matching profiles apply equally; each player and each push target is used only once per ring, by the first matching profile. A profile may have only push or only sound.

data_description.from: If To is before From, the window spans midnight (e.g. 22:00 to 06:00). It belongs to the weekday it starts on. From = To means all day.

sound.name: Sound
sound.description: Optional. Without media players this profile plays no sound.

notifications.name: Notification
notifications.description: Optional. App push of this profile.

data.clear_after_hours: Clear push after X hours (0 = never)

data_description.mobile_targets: Devices with the Home Assistant companion app. Multiple devices possible.

pool_menu.title: Pool control
pool_menu.description: Pump, time windows, dry-run detection and heater of the pool control.

data.action: What would you like to do?

window_edit.title: Time window
window_edit.description: The pump is switched on at the start and off at the end. If the end is earlier than the start, the window runs past midnight. The days refer to the day the window starts.

dry_run.title: Dry-run detection
dry_run.description: Detects a pump running dry: the pump is on and the power stays between the lower and upper limit for the set duration. Without a power sensor the feature is off. An alarm stays until acknowledged or the pump is restarted.

general.name: General
general.description: Power sensor and limits for dry-run detection.

data.dry_auto_off: Switch the pump off on dry run and pause the schedule

data_description.power_entity: Without a power sensor the detection is off.
data_description.dry_auto_off: The schedule is only re-enabled after acknowledging (button).

notifications.name: Notifications
notifications.description: How and with what a dry run is reported.

data_description.mobile_targets: Devices with the Home Assistant companion app. Multiple devices possible; sent via the notify.mobile_app_… service of the device.

heater.title: Pool heater
heater.description: Switches the heater by temperature: on at the switch-on threshold (or above), off at the switch-off threshold (or below); in between it stays as it is. Without a heater the function is off. The pump is not taken into account.

data_description.heater_entity: Leave empty to not control a heater.
data_description.heater_off_below: Must be below the switch-on threshold (hysteresis).

knx_menu.title: KNX/Sonos-Connector
knx_menu.description: Speaker profiles plus commands (KNX to Sonos) and status feedback (Sonos to KNX) per profile.

data.action: What would you like to do?

speaker_edit.title: Speaker profile
speaker_edit.description: A profile ties a Sonos speaker to its settings. Commands and status feedback each belong to one profile and have their own group addresses.

data.name: Name
data.stop_instead_of_pause: Stop instead of pause (e.g. for radio streams)

data_description.max_volume: Caps every volume set via KNX.
data_description.volume_step: Applies to volume up, volume down and relative dimming.

command_basic.title: Command (KNX to Sonos)
command_basic.description: Runs when a write telegram arrives on the group address.

data_description.dpt: Relative dimming (3.007) belongs to the action "Dim volume", "Mute (value)" needs switching (1.001).

data_description.favorite: Title of the favorite as shown in the Sonos app.

status_edit.title: Status feedback (Sonos to KNX)
status_edit.description: The value is sent on every change; read requests on the address are answered.

data_description.source: Playing, paused and muted are sent as 1 bit (1.001), volume as percent (5.001) and title, artist, album and source as text (16.001, 14 characters).

upd_menu.title: Home Assistant Updater
upd_menu.description: Schedules and settings of the updater.

data.action: What would you like to do?

data_description.timeout_minutes: After this time an update counts as failed and the run continues.

schedule_edit.title: Schedule
schedule_edit.description: Time, actions and notification of this schedule. At the set time on the selected weekdays the selected components and updates are reported or installed if an update is available.

data_description.trigger: “At a set time” runs on the selected weekdays. “As soon as an update becomes available” runs shortly after a new update is reported for one of the selected targets; time and weekdays are then ignored.
data_description.window_start: Only for “As soon as an update becomes available”, optional. Outside the window the run waits and is made up when it opens (also across midnight). Both fields empty = any time.

data_description.components: Whole components to update. They are determined anew on every run, so an add-on installed later is included automatically. Supervisor, Core and OS are always installed last; after a failure they are skipped, and at most one restart (Core or OS) is performed per run.
data_description.targets: Additionally individual update entities, e.g. a specific add-on or an ESPHome device. Select at least components or individual updates.
data_description.backup: Only for updates that support a backup.

notifications.name: Notifications
notifications.description: How and with what this schedule reports.

data_description.mobile_targets: Devices with the Home Assistant companion app. Multiple devices possible; sent via the notify.mobile_app_… service of the device.

task_edit.title: Task
task_edit.description: The actions run as soon as one of the triggers (next step) occurs. Messages go to the channels selected in the settings.

data_description.actions: Any Home Assistant actions, e.g. service calls, delays, conditions or a notification. The variables trigger and task are available in the actions.

task_triggers.title: Triggers
task_triggers.description:
Task "{task}". As soon as one of these triggers occurs, the task runs:
{triggers}

data.action: What would you like to do?

data_description.month_day: Only for "Specific day". If the month is shorter, the last day is used.

data_description.minutes: Counted from the start of the task planner (Home Assistant start or reload).

data_description.to_state: State text, e.g. on, home, open. Empty = any state change.

data_description.above: Fires when the value rises above this value.
data_description.below: Fires when the value falls below this value. Both set = range.

alarm_edit.title: Alarm
alarm_edit.description: At the alarm time the volume is set and the audio file is played. On stop or snooze the original volume is restored.

data_description.media: File or stream from the Home Assistant media browser.
data_description.only_if_on: Only if at least one of the selected sensors is on (OR), e.g. workday sensor. An unavailable sensor counts as met. The selection only appears if sensors are set in the settings.
data_description.skip_if_on: Not as soon as one of the selected sensors is on (OR), e.g. holiday sensor.
data_description.snooze_minutes: The alarm rings again after this time.
data_description.auto_stop_minutes: The alarm ends after this time if nobody reacts (per ring, also after snoozing).

mailbox_sensitivity.title: Sensitivity
mailbox_sensitivity.description: Value for {entity}. It is not sent automatically: wake the sensor on the device, then press the "Send sensitivity" button.

entry_id.description: Optional. Without it, all pool pumps are affected.

entity_missing.title: Entity missing: {entity}
entity_missing.description: The function "{entry}" ({function}) uses the entity {entity}, which no longer exists (deleted or renamed). Select an existing entity in the settings of the function or restore the entity. This notice disappears by itself as soon as it exists again or is no longer used.

device_missing.title: Push target missing: {entity}
device_missing.description: The function "{entry}" ({function}) sends push notifications to a device ({entity}) that no longer exists (e.g. the companion app was removed). Select an existing device in the settings. This notice disappears by itself as soon as the target is valid again.
